summary: Full backend pytest suite (21 tests) all passing, covering auth, datasets, EDA, cleaning, ML (regression/classification/clustering/forecasting), Claude Sonnet 4.5 SSE chat streaming, insights, reports CRUD, and notifications. Frontend end-to-end Playwright run covered landing, signup->/app redirect, dashboard, dataset upload, ML Studio classification training with accuracy displayed, chat streaming with assistant response rendered, and reports create form. All critical flows work.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> nested inside <option> due to instrumentation wrapper (x-ve-dynamic span). Non-blocking, but pollutes console with 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' errors. Consider ensuring option children render as plain text only.

action_items: Optional: silence hydration warning by ensuring <option> children are plain strings (avoid the ve-instrumented span wrapper). Not user-visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 628 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, datasets, ml, chat, reports) for maintainability.
get_current_user correctly excludes _id via projection and password_hash is popped before returning - good.
Cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True works only over HTTPS which is fine for preview URL.
Chat streaming persists assistant content only on stream completion; if client disconnects mid-stream, partial content is not saved (edge case).
Report generation on frontend awaits insights (LLM ~10-30s) before creating report; consider generating insights server-side or after report creation to improve UX.
ML target select does not filter numeric vs categorical - users can pick 'species' for regression and get a 400. Acceptable but could improve UX.
seed_data_creation: In-memory iris-like CSV (20 rows, 5 cols) uploaded via multipart
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. Each run creates a fresh user with UUID email. Reports frontend flow can take 15-30s because it fetches EDA + Claude insights before POST /reports; wait accordingly in Playwright.
